name: Terrorizer and Enduring raise damage against targets below 35% health (#3612, #1664)
contract: Terrorizer 806210 effect 0 and Enduring 300585 effect 0 are both aura 112 (SPELL_AURA_OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS) with MiscValue 20007 and MiscValueB 13 (AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT), BasePoints 24 / DieSides 1, i.e. 25%. The native contract the core honours is the mirror image: aura 303 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE with the state in MiscValue and 20007 (ASCENSION_CLASSMASK_AURASTATE_DAMAGE) in MiscValueB, read by Unit.cpp:8831 and Unit.cpp:10741. Terrorizer's class mask (2097152, 8388608, 16384) covers Veinburst, Bloodfang Bite and Claw Sweep (plus Crimson Maw, a Claw Sweep sibling the tooltip does not name); Enduring's (0, 131072, 0) covers Bloodbolt. 504820 and 578305 are the Veinburst and Bloodbolt ranks a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Enduring's second clause is effect 1, a native ADD_PCT_MODIFIER / SPELLMOD_DAMAGE of 25% that already worked and is asserted here as a regression. spell_damage_done queries Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone with a fixed base of 1000 and does not apply SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, so it isolates the aura-state multiplier.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Bloodbolt damage modifier before Enduring
Enduring's flat Bloodbolt modifier already worked (regression)
Let Unit::Update refresh the aura state
Terrorizer adds 25% against a target below 35% health
Enduring adds a further 25% against a target below 35% health
